change: Source eligibility only. Excludes meaning-preserving pairs that directly substitute 'will' with 'shall', because the frozen modal scale assigns 'will' (moderate, class 2) and 'shall' (strong, class 3) to different classes.
exclusion_rule: analysis_family == 'invariance' AND operation == 'rule_modal_synonym' AND source_base_first_modal_class == 2 AND source_probe_first_modal_class == 3
rule_inputs: Source-side fields and operation metadata only; no model output, score, or human label.
